jump_table_0x39ec_disasm.summary: STATIC-RE of the classifier post-pass dispatch at wmaze 0x39ec (the technique that cracked the index law). The dispatch keys on the per-slot wall CODE [0x363c] (range 0..0xd) and seeds the per-(depth,side) emit gate. TWO jump tables, both delta 0x4564 (the wmaze overlay CS→file delta confirmed from the 0x44c4 `cs:[bx-0x75fe]` shape table @file 0x449e).

dispatch_1.instr: 0x39e4 cmp ax,0xe; 0x39e7 jae 0x39f1; 0x39e9 xchg bx,ax; 0x39ea shl bx,1; 0x39ec jmp word cs:[bx+0x7f2c]
dispatch_1.input: ax = [0x363c] (the wall CODE, set by the edge-read + decoration override; 0..0xd valid, ≥0xe → 0x39f1 tail)

handlers.codes_0_4_5_0xc: 0x38f0 — door-frame / occlusion path: if [0x363c]==0xc AND z<9 sets the deep span [0x5050]; else 0x3919 sets the closed-doorway corner gate [0x5067]=1, then ax=[bp+0xe] (side param) → 0x3966 gate-CLEAR selector.
handlers.codes_1: 0x397d — sets [bx+0x50ab]=1 AND [bx+0x5043]=1 (bx=depth·3+sideParam): the side surface EMITS at this (depth,side).
handlers.codes_8_0xa: 0x39ac — sets word [bx+0x5050]=1 (bx=(depth·3+sideParam)·2): the deep-special span path.
handlers.codes_7_9: 0x39f1 — the SOLID / full-height tail (does NOT set the emit gate): reads spec1 ([0x4faa]+0x49a); if ==1, the SECOND dispatch (0x3a42) runs; else falls to the opaque edge-classify 0x3a47.

dispatch_1.gate_clear_selector_0x3966: cmp ax,0xffff je 0x3931 (clear left gates [0x5072/0x507a/0x5082]); cmp ax,0 je 0x3946 (clear front gate [0x508a]); cmp ax,1 je 0x3951 (clear right gates [0x5092/0x509a/0x50a2]). ax = side param [bp+0xe]. These CLEAR (=suppress emit) for occlusion; the emit gates default-set elsewhere and are checked `cmp [gate],1; jne skip` in the build loop (0x4d99/0x4ed5/0x4f03).

dispatch_2.instr: 0x3a39 cmp ax,0xe; jae 0x3a47; 0x3a3f xchg bx,ax; 0x3a40 shl bx,1; 0x3a42 jmp word cs:[bx+0x7f82]
dispatch_2.input: ax = [0x363c] again (runs only when spec1==1 at 0x39ff)

handlers.codes_2_5_7_9: 0x3a47 — the opaque edge-classify (full-height / solid): does NOT set the emit gate.

jump_table_0x39ec_disasm.side_param: [bp+0xe] = 0 (front, slot[0x5220]), 0xffff (left, slot[0x5226]), 1 (right, slot[0x5228]). The gate bx = depth·3 + sideParam → the gate array is per-(depth,side). So the side-wall surface FIRES at (depth, side) iff the lateral-neighbour's forward edge classifies to a NON-opaque code (i.e. NOT 2/5/7/9 — the solid/full-height codes). This is the cell-level meaning of 'the corridor is open to that side at that depth'.
